Paradise → Camp Muir.notes: Skyline Trail past Glacier Vista and Panorama Point, then the Muir Snowfield once the trail ends near 7,200 ft; about 4,600 ft of gain to Muir. Fog and whiteout are common and wind can erase the boot track, so carry navigation. Weather-exposed but not glaciated.

Camp Muir → Cathedral Gap.notes: Rope up on the Cowlitz Glacier, where crevasses are a constant hazard. The route crosses gently east to Cathedral Gap, near 10,640 ft, which is snow-covered early in the season.

Ingraham Flats.notes: Crevassed bench near 11,100 ft, a common place to rest or camp before the summit push; the route leaves the Cleaver line here, which is in view to the right with the icefall above. Crevasse opening varies with the season.

Upper glacier to crater rim.notes: Weave through crevasses on the established line, mostly 25-30 degrees. Early in the season ladder crossings and fixed pickets may be in place, and bridges sag as it warms. The rim is near 14,180 ft; the summit is about 230 ft higher across the crater.
